core_obligations: Reduce, using the resolution remark and the Cohomology on Sites criterion, to showing that u(P_bullet) -> B' is a quasi-isomorphism for a resolution P_bullet -> B (proof lines 1183-1188).
Show that the associated complex s(P_bullet) is a free A-module resolution of B (proof lines 1188-1192).
Conclude that B tensor_A^L A' is computed by s(P_bullet tensor_A A'), so that the hypothesis of the lemma is exactly the quasi-isomorphism needed (proof lines 1192-1194).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if the commutative square induces a quasi-isomorphism B tensor_A^L A' = B', then with the notation of the double square one has Lpi_!(g^{-1}F') = Lpi'_!(F') for abelian sheaves F' on the base-changed category (source lines 1174-1181). The proof applies the criterion of a Cohomology on Sites lemma: it is enough to show that for a resolution P_bullet -> B the induced map u(P_bullet) = P_bullet tensor_A A' -> B' is a quasi-isomorphism. It verifies this by observing that the associated complex s(P_bullet) is a free A-module resolution of B, so that B tensor_A^L A' is computed by s(P_bullet) tensor_A A', and hence the hypothesis of the lemma is exactly the statement that epsilon' is a quasi-isomorphism.
